card.title: One Missing Step
card.instruction: Treat the smallest skipped step as the beginning of systemic collapse. Escalate safeguards, documentation, and oversight before allowing anything to continue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The visitor book is missing your middle initial. Stop the tour.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We need a witness for amendments.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And who will confirm I was watching correctly?

mechanism: A halts a tour over a missing initial and expands witnessing requirements rather than permit a simple record correction.
confusable: To distinguish this from generic pedantry, the skipped detail must visibly threaten confidence in the wider system, not only annoy A.
comparison: The visitor alternative escalates witnesses to the correction; the kettle alternative creates a restart procedure when an ordered step was missed.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
